ns2:course.label: Game Development
ns2:course.description: A team and project-based course on the technical aspects of video game development and game engine internals: geometric modeling, game physics and AI, shader programming, real-time physically based rendering, and software engineering practices within the game industry. The central focus of the course is the development of a game by teams of 3 to 5 students. The course strongly emphasizes code development using a modern game engine. Students will gain skills necessary to develop games and to develop game engines. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CS 225.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CS 225.
